identity.title: Pocket Monsters Special Scarlet Violet volume 2

leadText: Volume 2 is the second volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
